intro: This is the Data Model Explorer. A single page that takes your data model, from a humble Excel workbook, all the way to a working Dataverse solution. Let us walk through it.
s1: First, open your workbook. Click Open workbook, or simply drag the file onto the page. Nothing is installed, and nothing ever leaves your machine.
s2: The Overview gives you the lie of the land. How many tables, fields and lookups there are, how well they are documented, and what needs your attention.
s3: Checks examines every table and every field, searching for trouble. Missing primary names. Lookups that lead nowhere. Relationships that do not add up. And it keeps watch as you edit.
s4: The diagram draws itself, from the lookups. Choose the tables you care about, and take the result with you, to draw dot io, as a picture, or as Mermaid.
s5: Every table has a page of its own. The primary key and the primary name are marked for you. To change a value, simply double click it.
s6: Adding a field is just as simple. Give it a name, and the logical and schema names follow, with your prefix. For a lookup, choose the table it points to, and the relationship is recorded for you.
s7: Every change you make is kept, and listed here. Any of them can be undone. One at a time, or all at once.
s8: When you are ready, write your changes back into the workbook. Only the cells you changed are touched, and the file is checked, before anything is saved.
s9: Finally, build the solution. Enter your publisher, check what will be created, and generate. A single download holds the solution, and a script to import it.
outro: Unzip it. Run the import script against a development environment. And your data model comes to life, in Dataverse. The full guide, with screenshots, is in the repository.
